head: lib/dispatch_client.py
intent: This change will add a per-tenant rate-limit resolver that returns the tenant-specific limit from the config API. Nothing else in the repository changes.

issues.title: Default rate limit silently impersonates a real tenant limit
issues.description: resolve_tenant_rate_limit falls back to DEFAULT_RATE_LIMIT (100) when the config API omits rate_limit; 100 is also a legitimate tenant limit, so a missing value is served as if it were real, with nothing logged.
